main_text.head: PRECATIO AD CHRISTVM.
main_text.p: CHRISTE tuū defende gregē, quem Papa scelestus Fraudibus & bellis undiq; ferme petit. Et quem diversis nunc Turca fatigat in oris, Qui nulli parcens, sanguine cuncta replet. Demonstra roburq; tuum, curamq; tuorum, Sentiat atq; iras hostis uterq; tuas. Ne nostri sceleris, sed fœderis illius almi sis memor & populū protege, CHRISTE, tuū.

page.notes: Decorative border strip above the title and a woodcut ornament (a face with scrollwork) below the verse are not transcribed. Faint mirrored text in the lower half is show-through and is excluded. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is clearly printed on this page.
